description: DocStudio brings your e-signature and document approval workflow into ChatGPT. Start a new envelope from one of your DocStudio templates, fill in its fields and tables, add attachments, choose who signs or approves, and send it out, or quick-send your own files for signature without a template. Ask ChatGPT to find envelopes in your inbox or sent box, check who has signed and who is still pending, read what a document says, or get it as a PDF. When something is waiting on you, you can approve or reject it right from the conversation; you can also cancel an envelope that is already out, delete unsent drafts, and organize envelopes with labels. Every action runs in your own DocStudio account, with the same permissions you have there, through secure OAuth sign-in.
